verdict.rationale: Rippling exposes a documented v2 REST API with auth, versioning, pagination, and even an MCP server for AI-native access, but the evidence never confirms full parity between API and UI capabilities—no explicit statement or comparison showing every UI action (e.g., all admin workflows, custom policy builders, device lifecycle actions) is reachable via API. missing for 10: explicit API-UI parity claim or documentation, coverage confirmation for admin/config workflows beyond REST CRUD, independent verification of completeness.
